description: A Python module for generating sales analytics reports in ERPNext, including data retrieval, processing, and chart preparation.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: A class for computing sales analytics, including data fetching, grouping, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes Analytics with filters and runs the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing filters, date field, months, and period ranges.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate columns, data, and chart data, and determine if total row should be skipped.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes sales transaction data based on report filters.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_order_type
methods.description: Retrieves sales data grouped by order type.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_customers_or_suppliers
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for customers or suppliers.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_items
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for items.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_customer_or_territory_group
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for customer or territory groups.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_item_group
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for item groups.

methods.name: get_sales_transactions_based_on_project
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for projects.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Processes entries into report rows grouped by entity.

methods.name: get_rows_by_group
methods.description: Processes grouped entries into report rows with hierarchy.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Aggregates data into periods for charting.

methods.name: get_period
methods.description: Calculates period label based on date and report range.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges
methods.description: Generates date ranges for report periods.

methods.name: get_groups
methods.description: Retrieves hierarchical group data for entities.

methods.name: get_teams
methods.description: Retrieves order type groups for report.

methods.name: get_supplier_parent_child_map
methods.description: Builds a map of suppliers to their groups.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart labels and datasets based on report data.
